responsibility: Declares the GCC tree structure-type interface used by COBOL code generation. It exposes the created tree nodes for libgcobol runtime structs and pointer variants, the create_our_type_nodes initializer, and helper functions for producing tree references to struct members or assigning nested member values when manipulating generated runtime objects.
same_name_distinction: Declares the runtime-structure tree nodes and member/member2/member3 helper APIs that other gcc/cobol files use; unlike structs.cc, it does not create the struct type descriptors or implement the accessors.
